ety: ยืมมาจากสันสกฤต गुण (คุณ, “คุณภาพ, คุณธรรม, คุณความดี”) หรือบาลี คุณ (“เส้น, สาย; ส่วนประกอบ; คุณภาพ, ผลประโยชน์, คุณความดี”); ร่วมเชื้อสายกับลาว ຄຸນ (คุน), คำเมือง ᨣᩩᨱ (คุณ), ไทลื้อ ᦅᦳᧃ (คุน)

from: คุณภาพ, คุณธรรม, คุณความดี

rule: คุณ files on the split its own EXTENDS chain draws: the core (6) is the good INHERENT in a thing, sense 7 is that good once it has been DONE TO SOMEONE, and sense 1 is the word that good becomes when it stands before a name. So every quality word — คุณภาพ, คุณสมบัติ, คุณธรรม, สรรพคุณ, and the คุณ of the Triple Gem — files at 6; the debt-and-gratitude words บุญคุณ, พระคุณ, ชนกคุณ, ขอบคุณ file at 7, because each names a benefit owed by one person to another rather than a property of a thing; the two title words คุณนาย and คุณตัว file at 1 with คุณพ่อ and คุณแม่, since they name a person and not a virtue. Grammar (8) takes คุณศัพท์. The decoration titles (2-4), the malefic rite (9) and the two pronouns (10-11) draw no compounds.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คุณ — the EXTENDS chain does the filing, and it divides three ways
notes.text:
Eleven senses, and the chain is the whole answer. The core (6) is the good
INHERENT in a thing. Sense 7 is that good **once it has been done to someone**
(*ความเกื้อกูล*). Sense 1 is what that good becomes **when it stands before a
name**. Every one of the twenty-one falls into one of those three, plus grammar.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คุณ — the EXTENDS chain does the filing, and it divides three ways
notes.text:
* **6, fourteen words** — the quality vocabulary: คุณภาพ, คุณสมบัติ, คุณวุฒิ,
  คุณประโยชน์, คุณธรรม, คุณธรรมนิยม (RID's own *meritocracy*), สรรพคุณ (a drug's
  properties), เกียรติคุณ and กิตติคุณ (renown by virtue), นพคุณ (nine-grade
  gold — the คุณ is the grade), and the three Triple-Gem words พุทธคุณ, ธรรมคุณ,
  สังฆคุณ.
* **7, four words** — บุญคุณ, พระคุณ, ชนกคุณ (a father's kindness), ขอบคุณ. Each
  names a benefit **owed between people**, not a property of a thing. That is the
  line between 6 and 7 and it holds for all four.
* **1, two words** — คุณนาย and **คุณตัว**. Both name a person rather than a
  virtue, which is sense 1's job (คุณพ่อ, คุณแม่, คุณสมร). คุณตัว, "a woman who
  keeps herself by prostitution", is the honorific used against its owner; I file
  it on form, with the irony noted rather than modelled.
* **8** — คุณศัพท์, the adjective.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คุณ — the EXTENDS chain does the filing, and it divides three ways
notes.text:
Nothing reaches 2-4 (the royal-decoration titles), 9 (คุณไสย, the malefic rite)
or 10-11 (the two pronouns). Four sense groups out of eleven carry every word.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คุณ — the EXTENDS chain does the filing, and it divides three ways
notes.text:
**คุณตะพาบ is a pun and files at 6.** Its etymology is `แผลงมาจาก คุณภาพ` —
ตะพาบ, the softshell turtle, swapped in for ภาพ. The gloss is *ไม่ค่อยมีคุณภาพ*.
The คุณ is still the quality.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: คุณ — the EXTENDS chain does the filing, and it divides three ways
notes.text:
**เณรคุณ, tagged `false-split` — and the reason is narrower than usual.** Its
gloss is *รูปสะกดผิดของ เนรคุณ*, and เนรคุณ is *แผลงมาจาก นิรคุณ*: the first
element is the privative นิร- "without", not เณร "novice". So the คุณ in it IS
this head's morpheme; what is false is the recorded split เณร + คุณ. Tagged with
that stated, because the usual false-split note ("the whole word is borrowed")
would be untrue here.
